description: Checks whether AI agents can use a page and its site: labelled forms and buttons, declared WebMCP tools, a Markdown version (content negotiation or a Link header), the agent files and MCP server cards under /.well-known, and whether the domain has an MCP server listed in the official MCP Registry. Use it when the person asks whether agents can complete tasks on the site or find its MCP server. result has checks (the agent checks with status and summary), webMcpTools, markdownVersion, agentFiles and mcpRegistry (listings by name, website or endpoint; null when the registry could not be read, an empty list when nothing is listed). Registry lookups are cached 6 hours. These are deterministic checks of public pages fetched by Agent Ready Website Audit, with no AI model and no account. They do not cover rankings, keyword volumes, backlinks or how AI answers mention the brand. Returns JSON: summary (one sentence), reportUrl (a shareable report page for the person, kept 30 days; null for tools that keep none) and result (the details below). Errors come back as one plain sentence. Recorded: the checked domain and path (never the query string), the tool, which checks failed and the app name; never an IP address or page text.

url.description: The page to check, usually the home page or a task page: an absolute http or https URL, such as https://example.com/pricing.
